interpretation: Anonymous HEAD requests return 403 AccessDenied (XML). On AWS S3, missing objects on a public-read bucket typically return 404; 403 for a fabricated key indicates the bucket (or object ACL) denies anonymous access. Therefore unsigned Storage::url() label_url values are NOT reliably externally accessible without credentials. No real customer label URLs were requested.
caveat: Could not HEAD a real object key without sandbox credentials. Bucket policy exceptions for specific prefixes remain possible but unverified.
